name: Unstaked Adjudication
definition: Whoever judges a contribution risks nothing on the judgment, so judgment is cheap and drifts.
trigger_conditions: Validators or reviewers stake nothing on their verdict
Verdicts are not contestable within a stated window
No standing consequence follows from a verdict later shown wrong

institutional_antecedent.mechanism: consequence attaching to the adjudicating party as the source of care

citation: W. A. Kaal, ed., Agent Failure Mode Registry version 1.0, AFMR-F018 Unstaked Adjudication. https://wulfkaal.github.io/afmr/AFMR-F018
assessment_note: State which trigger conditions the assessed design satisfies. Report this family as examined even where no exposure is found. A parameter recommendation stated without its conditions is not conforming output under section 7.
